review_kind: Root reconciliation of fresh independent whole-file/module approval

src/game/game_mode_native.cpp.reason: Fresh independent review approves the complete current native forwarding/explicit-stop module; no source rewrite required.
src/game/game_mode_native.cpp.semantic_justification: All 275 lines reviewed independently. Native accesses publish immediate typed stores and read borrowed values at use; sequence absence fails at the signed-level read. All 27 finite native forwards retain arguments, return bits, callback mutation and exceptions. Remaining uncomposed operations stop by name. The only successful empty module-request behavior has complete pinned instruction/disabled-printer evidence; no source owner, fixture knownness, address dispatch or guest transport is introduced.

resolved_owners.resolution: Session::flow_ is the native canonical flow value owner. Session bootstrap borrows flow_.movie_number; save/message/title/character-selection/input consumers access the same flow fields through Session/TitleScene views. FlowContext borrows GameFlowState and NativeServices synchronously, owns only a logical phase; the services pointer has no captured callable lifetime or deferred publication. SequenceSelection is a borrowed nullable game sequence, not fixture availability. MenuResource is an opaque zero/nonzero release token here; native free_message_resource remains an explicit failure, so this does not establish a native allocation/asset identity.

Reference GameModeRuntime borrows NativeGame::mode_at_3abdc7c_, loop_ pause/save/request/message fields and mode_state_ remaining bytes/movie/menu flag/sequence-level fact. Reference views are invocation-local, not second persistent owners. Accessors revalidate reached facts and publish actual stores immediately. Call-site phase metadata, required returns, args, pending calls, cancellation/owner/nested failures remain in guest/game_mode_reference; it calls the same structured core with no fallback interpreter. BindScope restores nested binding; nested call counters are adapter-local.

resolved_consumers.resolution: advance_game_mode(state) is consumed by the reference adapter and native explicit-stop unit. advance_game_mode(state,services) is consumed by Session::advance; one shared advance/finish_frame owns all mode decisions. Native backend calls a finite typed NativeServices operation set; Session privately implements it and owns/binds real resources. No generic callee IDs/registers/optional fixture facts cross that interface. Reference NativeGame composes timing/reset/leaves or reports unported owners; it is not native gameplay. Test resource baselines also derive from NativeServices and are fixtures, not additional production owners.

accepted_judges.resolution: Fresh independent complete-body STYLE12/spec review f9c5f09 approves exactly the native backend and finite service interface and accepts the bounded judge packet. All source fingerprints, complete streams, fault copies and observer payloads were verified read-only; no builds, original executions, mutations or holdouts reran. Integration is pending Root.
